entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Powerful monstrosities of limited intelligence, known by the Gruul Clans and venerated by the Cult of Yore as the Old Gods.

entities.name: Dune-Brood Nephilim
entities.description: A six-legged cross between a salamander and a bloated fish whose throat writhed with tiny imitations of itself.

entities.name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
entities.description: A serpentine nephilim with a single reptilian yellow eye, nicknamed Slither by Pivlic.

entities.name: Ink-Treader Nephilim
entities.description: A burrower resembling an octopus, jellyfish and tree on tentacles, nicknamed Brain by Pivlic.

entities.name: Witch-Maw Nephilim
entities.description: A tapered, eyeless tube of exposed muscle with a gaping toothy mouth.

entities.name: Yore-Tiller Nephilim
entities.description: A nephilim that looked like a rusted construct or living rock on three legs, nicknamed Stomper by Pivlic.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: A person who nicknamed several of the nephilim.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who killed two of the nephilim before flying away.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon who killed one of the nephilim in Ravnica City.

entities.name: Cult of Yore
entities.description: A faction that venerated the Nephilim as the Old Gods.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A faction that knew of the Nephilim.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Nephilim were imprisoned and awoke.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: The district where construction works awakened the nephilim.

entities.name: Ravnica City
entities.description: The city whose center the remaining three nephilim reached.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The occasion at which the Guildpact fell, coinciding with the Nephilim's return.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical pact that governed Ravnica's guilds, which fell at the Decamillennial.

events.summary: The Nephilim were subdued thousands of years before the Ravnica block and imprisoned deep below the plane's surface.
events.quote: The Nephilim were subdued thousands of years before the events of the Ravnica block

events.summary: Construction in the Utvara district awakens five nephilim, who feed on a dragon corpse and grow in size and power.
events.quote: five of the creatures fed on a dragon corpse and grew in size and power

events.summary: The nephilim's return coincides with the fall of the Guildpact at the Decamillennial.
events.quote: it coincided with the fall of the Guildpact at the Decamillennial

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet kills two nephilim but flies away after an unforeseen attack from another, claiming to have lost interest.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet killed two of them but flew away after an unforeseen attack

events.summary: The remaining three nephilim reach the center of Ravnica City, where Rakdos kills one and the last two die in mana explosions.
events.quote: Rakdos killed one of them, and the last two were killed by mana explosions.

relations.note: venerated them as the Old Gods
relations.quote: venerated by the Cult of Yore , who saw them as the "Old Gods."
